about: Real text from the corpus, one line each, for the normalization tests.
raw is a line as one source gives it: pypdfium2 or pdftotext reading the text layer, or dots.mocr reading the page.
printed is the same line in the hand-transcribed ground truth, checked against the page.
In same, normalization must make the two compare equal; in different, the damage is real and must survive it.
Presentation forms, invisible characters and combining marks are escaped, so no editor reorders or hides them.
Built by reading each source; the documents themselves are not redistributed.
